drafts.subject: Re: jac-cloud on Kubernetes?
drafts.message:
Hi Amara,

Thanks for reaching out. Here are the answers to your questions:

1. Yes, jac-cloud fully supports deployment on your own Kubernetes cluster, including Amazon EKS. You can use our Helm charts to deploy jac-cloud easily.

2. jac-cloud handles horizontal scaling of walkers automatically. Our platform includes an autoscaler that adjusts the number of walker replicas based on load, so you don't need to manage replicas manually.

If you need more detailed documentation or have additional questions, feel free to ask. We'd be happy to assist with your Q4 planning.

Best regards,

Impact Team
Jaseci
